summary.text: Golden Thread Sword is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move. Countless golden threads burst from the body and stab outward, piercing everything in their path.

claims.text: In a sword path dream realm, Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Golden Thread Sword. The threads stab toward his surroundings like a porcupine. The three Gu Immortals around him want to dodge but are too late; their bodies and souls are fully penetrated and they fall lifeless.

In Heavenly Court, after activating triple layered sword wave, Fang Yuan activates golden thread sword again. The sword dragon’s body turns hazy, every scale emits soft yellow light, and each scale shoots a golden thread; the threads are incomparably fast and pierce every obstacle in their way. Encircling dragonman Gu Immortals from Duke Long’s dragon offspring are riddled like honeycombs, then lose shape, detonate softly, and return to scales and blood.

Later in the same fight, after the second sword of five finger fist heart sword, Fang Yuan stops that move and turns to golden thread sword. Duke Long sees the dragon scales begin to flicker with yellow light and retreats far away with dragon gate, so countless golden threads cover every inch around Fang Yuan without catching him. The cast still lets Fang Yuan pull distance again and return to five finger fist heart sword.

Duke Long reads Fang Yuan’s sword path combat system as including immemorial sword dragon transformation, triple layered sword wave, golden thread sword, dark assassination, myriad thought sword waterfall, swordsman, and other methods, with five finger fist heart sword as the trump card.
